verdict.rationale: mParticle has a first-party 'Feeds' guide [mparticle-docs-28], which points to inbound ingestion from external sources, but the pack gives only its title and no content on which third-party cloud apps or feeds are supported. Warehouse Sync [mparticle-docs-x4] is well documented for ingesting non-instrumented data from Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery and Databricks. However, it pulls from the user's own warehouse rather than third-party apps, so it only partly covers the story. Missing for 10: documented details of inbound feed partners and setup, evidence of direct ingestion from third-party SaaS/cloud apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
